title.rendered: 🌟 Novinka na VivaDzen! 10-OH-HHC 🌟

content.rendered:
Představujeme vám náš nový produkt – 10-OH-HHC! Jedná se o jeden z nejmodernějších kanabinoidů, který vám otevře novou úroveň relaxace a harmonie.

🔹 Co je 10-OH-HHC?
10-OH-HHC je kanabinoid, který kombinuje vlastnosti HHC s ještě větší silou účinků. Tento produkt, známý svými vyváženými účinky, je vhodný jak pro začátečníky, tak pro ty, kteří se s kanabinoidy již seznámili.

🔹 Výhody 10-OH-HHC:

– Mírný a dlouhotrvající účinek: Poskytuje snadný a stabilní stav uvolnění bez zbytečné stimulace.
– Kreativní povzbuzení: Pokud hledáte inspiraci, 10-OH-HHC vám pomůže soustředit se a objevit nové nápady. Ideální pro ty, kteří chtějí uplatnit svou kreativitu.
– Zlepšení nálady: Pocit lehkosti a povznesení vám pomůže zůstat pozitivní i v obtížných situacích.

⚡️ Neodkládejte! Množství je omezené, proto si pospěšte a vyzkoušejte něco nového. Objednávejte nyní na VivaDzen a pociťte sílu 10-OH-HHC ještě dnes!

title.rendered: Novinka ve VivaDzen! 🍄Cordyceps🍄

content.rendered:
Představte si přírodní dar, který po staletí fascinoval mysli a srdce lidí na Východě. V našem obchodě VivaDzen je nyní k dispozici tento úžasný poklad – Cordyceps, houba, která se považuje za zázrak čínské medicíny.

Co je Cordyceps?
Tato unikátní houba je známá svými pozoruhodnými vlastnostmi:
– Zvyšuje energii a vytrvalost. Cordyceps podporuje tvorbu adenosintrifosfátu (ATP), hlavního zdroje energie v našich buňkách.
– Posiluje imunitní systém. Beta-glykany obsažené v cordycepsu posilují obranyschopnost těla a pomáhají bojovat s nakaženími.
– Chrání před stresem. Antioxidanty chrání buňky před škodlivými volnými radikály.

Proč si vybrat Cordyceps?
– 18 aminokyselin, vč. serotoninu
– Antioxidační sloučeniny
– Vitamíny B, D, E, K podporující váš metabolismus a celkové zdraví.
– Minerály jako draslík, sodík, vápník, hořčík, železo a mangan jsou důležitým základem pro normální fungování organismu.
– Koenzym Q10 a bílkoviny podporující energetický metabolismus v buňkách.

Srdečně zveme vás, abyste zažili léčivou sílu Cordycepsu ve VivaDzen. Svěřte své zdraví přírodě a užívejte si život naplno!

title.rendered: Dlouhotrvající energie a relaxace -50 %! Bílá Maeng Da a Bílý Slon

Bílá Maeng Da je váš ideální partner pro zvýšení energie a koncentrace. Ať je každý váš den produktivní a plný energie.

PŘEJÍT NA KATALOG

Vyzkoušejte všechny výhody kratomu bez potíží. Naše tablety jsou dokonalou kombinací pohodlí a účinnosti.

Proč jsou kratomové tablety nejlepší:

title.rendered: Novinka ve VivaDzen: Objevte THC-F1 produkty!

content.rendered:
Milí přátelé, rádi vám přinášíme novinky! VivaDzen se rozšířil o nejnovější produkty na bázi THC-F1. Tento revoluční kanabinoid přináší inovace a kvalitu, kterou hledáte. Pojďme se ponořit do světa THC-F1 a zjistit, co dělá tyto produkty tak výjimečnými.

Naše nabídka produktů THC-F1:

1. Jednorázové vaporizátory (vape pens)
Naše jednorázové vaporizátory s THC-F1 jsou ideální pro ty, kteří hledají okamžitou připravenost a jednoduchost použití. Bez potřeby nabíjení nebo plnění si můžete vychutnat příchutě Cherry a Passion fruit.

2. Сartridge
Pokud již máte vaporizátor s odpovídajícím závitem, naše THC-F1 сartridge budou skvělým doplňkem. Snadno vyměnitelné a dostupné s příchutí Grapefruit, Lemon Haze a Strawberry Banana, vám poskytnou jedinečné zážitky.

3. Pre-rolls
Připravené k použití THC-F1 jointy nabízejí ideální kombinaci pohodlí a tradičního způsobu konzumace. Vyzkoušejte naše varianty s příchutí Gelato, Lemon Haze a Strawberry Kush a oceňte jejich vysokou kvalitu.

4. Květy
V nabídce květů THC-F1 naleznete širokou škálu možností pro klasické použití. Tyto květy jsou vhodné pro použití v dýmkách, bongách a jointéch a uspokojí chutě každého znalce.

Proč si vybrat produkty THC-F1:

– Jednoduchost a pohodlí: Naše jednorázové vaporizátory, cartridge a pre-rolls zajišťují okamžitou připravenost a flexibilitu v použití.
– Rozmanitost příchutí: Příchutě našich produktů THC-F1 se pohybují od svěžích a ovocných až po intenzivní a exotické, což umožňuje každému najít něco podle svého gusta.
– Inovace a kvalita: THC-F1 není jen nový kanabinoid. Je symbolem vysoké kvality a unikátních vlastností, které jej činí jedinečnou volbou pro mnoho spotřebitelů.

title.rendered: Kratom in ancient rituals: a historical overview and modern practices

content.rendered:
1. Introduction

Kratom (Mitragyna speciosa) is a tropical tree that grows in Southeast Asia. Its leaves have played an important role in traditional medicine and cultural practices in this region for centuries. Belonging to the Rubiaceae family, this plant is known for its unique properties, which have attracted the attention of local residents since ancient times.

In the cultures of Southeast Asian countries such as Thailand, Malaysia, and Indonesia, kratom has a special status. Its significance goes beyond that of a simple medicine—it is an integral part of the social structure of society, an element of spiritual practices, and a symbol of the connection between humans and nature. Kratom leaves were used not only to relieve physical ailments, but also as a tool to achieve altered states of consciousness necessary in various rituals and ceremonies.

2. Historical roots of kratom use

The first mentions of kratom in historical sources date back several centuries. However, oral traditions and archaeological finds suggest that the use of this plant may have begun much earlier, possibly as far back as prehistoric times.

One of the oldest written accounts of kratom use can be found in the notes of Dutch colonizers who came to Southeast Asia in the 17th century. They described how local people chewed the leaves of the plant to increase work performance and relieve pain.

The geographical spread of traditional kratom use has been largely limited to areas where it occurs naturally. This includes:

– Southern Thailand, particularly the provinces of Nakhon Si Thammarat, Phatthalung, and Satun

– The peninsular part of Malaysia

– The islands of Indonesia, particularly Kalimantan (Borneo) and Sumatra

– Some areas of Myanmar (Burma) and Papua New Guinea

Each of these regions developed its own traditions of kratom use, reflecting local culture and beliefs. In Thailand, for example, kratom was often associated with rural culture and was used by workers to increase their stamina during long working days in the fields.

Interestingly, despite their geographical proximity, kratom use did not spread to some neighboring countries, such as Vietnam or Cambodia. This highlights the uniqueness and local character of the traditions associated with this plant.

With the development of trade routes and cultural exchange, knowledge of kratom gradually spread beyond its original area of occurrence, laying the foundations for its current global spread and interest in other parts of the world.

3. Kratom in traditional rituals

The use of kratom in traditional rituals in Southeast Asia was multifaceted and deeply rooted in local culture. Let’s look at the main aspects of its use:

Religious ceremonies:

In some animistic beliefs of the region, kratom was considered a sacred plant gifted by the spirits. Shamans and spiritual leaders used it to achieve altered states of consciousness, which they believed allowed them to communicate with ancestral and nature spirits. In Thailand, for example, kratom leaves were sometimes included in offerings to spirits during important ceremonies.

Social rituals:

Kratom played an important role in the social life of communities. In Malaysia, there was a tradition of offering guests a drink made from kratom leaves as a sign of hospitality. In some Thai villages, the communal use of kratom was part of rituals that strengthened community bonds, especially among men.

Healing practices:

Traditional healers used kratom in various healing rituals. It was used to treat diarrhea, coughs, diabetes, and to relieve pain. In some communities, there were complex rituals for preparing medicinal mixtures with kratom, accompanied by prayers and incantations.

4. The symbolic meaning of kratom in different cultures

Kratom as a symbol of endurance and strength:

In cultures where kratom was traditionally used, it often symbolized endurance and strength. Plantation and field workers chewed kratom leaves to cope with hard physical labor. This led to the plant being associated with hard work and resilience. In some communities in Thailand, there was a saying: „Strong as one who chews kratom.“

Spiritual aspects of kratom use:

In spiritual practices, kratom symbolized the connection between the physical and spiritual worlds. Shamans believed that the plant opened the „door of perception,“ allowing them to interact with the spiritual world of existence. In some animistic beliefs in Indonesia, kratom was considered the embodiment of the spirit of wisdom and healing.

In Malaysian culture, kratom was sometimes associated with the concept of „semangat“ – life force or soul. It was believed that using kratom could strengthen a person’s „semangat,“ making them more resilient to life’s hardships.

It is interesting to note that in some communities, kratom had dual symbolism. On the one hand, it symbolized strength and endurance, and on the other, moderation and self-control, as excessive use was considered a sign of weak character.

In the modern context, the symbolic meaning of kratom continues to evolve. For some, it has become a symbol of traditional wisdom and connection to one’s roots, while for others, it symbolizes the contradictions between traditional practices and modern legislation.

These rich cultural associations and symbolic meanings of kratom underscore its importance not only as a plant with certain properties, but also as an integral part of the cultural heritage of the peoples of Southeast Asia.

5. Methods of preparation and use in ancient rituals

Traditional methods of harvesting and processing leaves:

In ancient cultures, the harvesting of kratom leaves was surrounded by rituals and superstitions. It was believed that the best time for harvesting was early in the morning, when the dew had not yet dried. The leaves were usually collected by older members of the community or specially designated people who knew the correct prayers and sacrifices to the plant spirits.

After collection, the leaves were usually dried in the sun, sometimes crushed beforehand. In some regions, the leaves were fermented by burying them in the ground for several days, which was believed to increase their effects.

Ritual drinks and mixtures:

  1. „Kratom tea“: The most common method. The dried leaves were boiled in hot water, often with honey or lemon added for flavor.
  2. „Chewing balls“: Fresh leaves were chewed, sometimes mixed with betel and lime.
  3. „Ritual paste“: The leaves were crushed with water into a paste that was used to apply to the body during certain ceremonies.
  4. „Smoke rituals“: In some shamanic practices, kratom leaves were

burned and the smoke was used to purify a space or for healing purposes.

6. The evolution of kratom use: from ancient times to the present day

Changes in the understanding and use of kratom:

Over time, the use of kratom has changed significantly:

  1. From ritual to everyday: While kratom was previously used primarily for ritual purposes, it has gradually become part of everyday life, especially among the working class.
  2. Medical use: The traditional medicinal use of kratom has attracted the attention of modern medicine, leading to scientific research into its properties.
  3. Recreational use: In some societies, kratom has come to be used as an alternative to alcohol or other mind-altering substances.
  4. Global spread: With the development of international trade, kratom has crossed its traditional boundaries and become known in many countries around the world.

The impact of colonization and globalization on traditional practices:

The colonial period significantly influenced the perception and use of kratom:

  1. Bans and restrictions: Colonial authorities often considered traditional practices to be „backward“ or „dangerous,“ leading to restrictions on the use of kratom in some regions.
  2. Scientific interest: European scientists began to study the properties of kratom, which led to its inclusion in the pharmacopoeias of some countries.
  3. Cultural exchange: Globalization has contributed to the spread of information about kratom, leading to its popularization outside its traditional areas of use.
  4. Commercialization: In many places, the traditional ritual use of kratom has given way to commercial production and distribution.
  5. Legislative changes: Various laws regulating the use of kratom have been adopted in different countries, affecting traditional practices.

These changes have led to today’s perception and use of kratom being significantly different from what it was in ancient times. However, elements of the traditional ritual use of this plant still persist in some communities in Southeast Asia.

7. Modern non-traditional practices

Kratom use in new spiritual movements:

In recent decades, kratom has found its place in various non-traditional and new spiritual practices:

  1. Neo-shamanism: Some Western neo-shamanistic practices have incorporated kratom into their rituals, often combining it with meditation or other altered consciousness techniques.
  2. Psychonautics: Experimenters in the field of consciousness expansion use kratom as a tool for self-discovery and spiritual growth.
  3. Alternative medicine: Kratom has become part of holistic approaches to health, where it is used to treat chronic pain, anxiety, and depression.
  4. Yoga and meditation: Some practitioners use small doses of kratom to deepen meditative states or improve concentration during yoga.

Adapting ancient rituals to a modern context:

Traditional practices of kratom use have been adapted to modern realities:

  1. Kratom ceremonies: Some eco-communities and retreat centers hold ceremonies inspired by traditional kratom use but adapted for a modern audience.
  2. Microdosing: The practice of taking small doses of kratom on a regular basis to increase productivity and creativity.
  3. Digital rituals: Online communities create virtual spaces for sharing experiences and holding „digital ceremonies“ involving kratom use.
  4. Art therapy: Some artists and musicians integrate kratom into their creative practices, producing works of art under its influence.

8. Contradictions and debates

Cultural appropriation vs. intercultural exchange:

The use of kratom outside its traditional context provokes debate:

  1. Arguments about cultural appropriation: Some critics argue that Western use of kratom without understanding its cultural significance is a form of exploitation.
  2. The intercultural exchange perspective: Supporters speak of mutual cultural enrichment and the dissemination of ancient wisdom.
  3. Questions of authenticity: Debates about the extent to which modern practices correspond to traditional rituals.
  4. Economic aspects: Discussion about the impact of global demand for kratom on local communities in Southeast Asia.

Legality and ethics of modern ritual practices:

The use of kratom for ritual purposes faces legal and ethical challenges:

  1. Legal status: Kratom has different legal statuses in different countries, which affects the possibility of its ritual use.
  2. Religious freedom: Discussion of the right to use kratom in religious and spiritual practices in countries where it is banned.
  3. Safety and responsibility: Questions about how to ensure the safe use of kratom in a ritual context.
  4. Ethics of dissemination: Debates about the ethics of popularizing kratom outside of traditional cultures, particularly with regard to the risks of addiction.
  5. Preserving traditions: Discussions about how to preserve authentic ritual practices in the context of globalization and commercialization.

These contradictions and debates reflect the complexity of integrating traditional practices into a modern global context, highlighting the need for a respectful and conscious approach to cultural heritage.

9. Scientific perspective on the traditional use of kratom

Research by ethnobotanists and anthropologists:

The scientific community has shown significant interest in the traditional use of kratom:

  1. Ethnobotanical studies: Scientists are investigating the different varieties of kratom used in traditional practices and their specific properties.
  2. Anthropological observations: Researchers are documenting the rituals and customs associated with kratom in various cultures of Southeast Asia.
  3. Linguistic studies: Analysis of local names and terminology associated with kratom helps to understand its cultural significance.

Potential medical applications based on traditional use:

Traditional use of kratom has inspired a number of modern medical studies:

  1. Analgesic properties: Researching kratom alkaloids for the development of new analgesics.
  2. Addiction treatment: Researching the potential of kratom in opioid addiction therapy, based on traditional practices.
  3. Antidepressant effects: Investigating the effect of kratom on mood and its potential in the treatment of depression.
  4. Anti-inflammatory properties: Investigating the traditional use of kratom for the treatment of various inflammatory conditions.

10. Conclusion

The importance of preserving cultural heritage:

The traditional use of kratom is an important

part of the cultural heritage of Southeast Asia. Preserving this knowledge and these practices is important not only for understanding the history and culture of the region, but also for its potential contribution to modern science and medicine.

Balancing tradition and modernity in kratom use:

As kratom becomes increasingly well-known around the world, it is important to find a balance between respecting traditional practices and adapting to modern realities. This includes:

  1. Supporting research: Promoting studies that examine the traditional use of kratom and its potential modern applications.
  2. Developing ethical guidelines: Creating guidelines for kratom use that take into account its cultural significance.
  3. Promoting dialogue: Encouraging dialogue between traditional practices and modern science for mutual enrichment of knowledge.

At our VivaDzen store, we offer a wide range of kratom that pays tribute to its rich cultural history. We strive to provide our customers not only with a quality product, but also with information about its traditional use and cultural significance.

By purchasing kratom at the VivaDzen store, you become part of a centuries-old tradition. We invite you to familiarize yourself with our offer and learn more about the different types of kratom, their origins, and traditional uses.

Please remember that the use of kratom requires a responsible approach and respect for its cultural heritage. We are always ready to answer your questions and provide further information about the cultural context and proper use of kratom.

title.rendered: Novinky ve VivaDzen: TH4C produkty!

content.rendered:
Přátelé, s radostí vám oznamujeme, že se v našem obchodě VivaDzen objevily nové produkty na bázi TH4C! Jedná se o inovativní produkty, které si rychle získaly oblibu díky svým jedinečným vlastnostem a pohodlnému používání. Pojďme se na tyto produkty a jejich výhody podívat blíže.

Výhody produktů TH4C:

– Pohodlí při používání: Jednorázové vaporizéry a pre-rolly jsou připraveny k použití ihned po zakoupení a cartridge lze snadno vyměnit pro maximální pohodlí.
– Rozmanitost příchutí: Výrobky TH4C jsou k dispozici v mnoha příchutích, takže si každý může najít něco podle své chuti.
– Inovace: TH4C je nový kanabinoid, který si rychle získává oblibu díky svým jedinečným vlastnostem a vysoké kvalitě výrobků.

Typy produktů TH4C:

1. Květy
Květy TH4C se dodávají v několika variantách, aby vyhovovaly chuti každého. Poskytují tradiční způsob konzumace a jsou ideální pro použití v dýmkách, bongách nebo pro vlastní vaping.

2. Jednorázové vaporizéry (vape pera)
– Naše jednorázová vapovací pera jsou lehká a snadno použitelná, naplněná TH4C a přírodními terpeny. Jsou připravena k použití ihned po vybalení z krabice, bez nutnosti nabíjení nebo doplňování. Mezi oblíbené příchutě patří třešeň (Cherry) a marakuja (Passion fruit).

3. Cartridge
– Pro ty, kteří již mají vaporizéry s vhodnými závity, nabízíme TH4C cartridge. Snadno se vyměňují a jsou k dispozici v různých příchutích, například Grapefruit, Lemon haze a Strawberry Banana.

4. Pre-rolls.
– Pre-rolly TH4C připravené k použití, které nevyžadují žádnou další přípravu. Jsou k dispozici v příchutích Gelato, Lemon Haze a Strawberry Kush, takže jsou ideální volbou pro ty, kteří dávají přednost tradičním způsobům konzumace.

Legenda praví, že dávní afričtí léčitelé objevili zvláštní vlastnosti plodů Goron Tula, když sledovali zvířata, která si na těchto plodech pochutnávala a vykazovala neobyčejnou energii a zdraví. Když tyto plody sami ochutnali, lidé objevili skutečný poklad přírodní síly.
Zázračné Plody
Plody Goron Tula, jako zlaté perly, v sobě ukrývají mnoho prospěšných vlastností:
Reprodukční zdraví: Jsou známé svou schopností zvyšovat libido a zlepšovat plodnost, čímž se tento dar přírody stává nepostradatelným pro mnoho párů.
Antioxidanty: Jejich antioxidační vlastnosti pomáhají bojovat proti stárnutí, udržují mládí a energii.
Trávení: Zlepšují funkci gastrointestinálního traktu, pomáhají každý den cítit lehkost a komfort.
Imunita: Tyto plody zvyšují odolnost organismu vůči nemocem, dodávají sílu a výdrž.
Péče o pokožku: Dokážou hydratovat a obnovovat pokožku, činí ji zářivou a zdravou.
Kouzlo Konzumace
Když si pochutnáte na plodech Goron Tula, pocítíte sladkost přírody. Můžete je konzumovat čerstvé nebo sušené, přidávat je do oblíbených jídel nebo je proměnit v džusy a džemy. Žvýkačka z těchto plodů vám poskytne přírodní svěžest a dávku energie.
Cesta k Přírodě
Každý plod Goron Tula v sobě nese kousek tropického lesa, kde život bují a kvete. Tyto plody jsou ztělesněním síly přírody, která dokáže darovat zdraví a krásu každému, kdo objeví tento kouzelný svět.
Objednejte si je přímo teď u nás a pocítíte kouzlo Goron Tula. Nechte přírodu, aby o vás pečovala, a naplnila vás silou a energií.

title.rendered: The potential of kratom in sports nutrition: myths and reality

content.rendered:
1. Introduction

Kratom, or Mitragyna speciosa, is a tropical tree native to Southeast Asia whose leaves have been used in traditional medicine for centuries. In recent years, the plant has attracted the attention of the athletic community due to its potential properties that may improve physical performance and endurance.

Kratom’s popularity among athletes is growing every year. More and more athletes, from amateurs to professionals, are turning to this plant in search of a natural means of enhancing their performance. However, the use of kratom in sports is the subject of heated debate, and expert opinions often differ.

2. The proclaimed benefits of kratom for athletes

Proponents of kratom use in sports nutrition attribute a number of beneficial properties to it:

Increased endurance: Many athletes claim that kratom helps them train longer and more intensely. This may be related to the stimulating effect of the alkaloids contained in the plant, which, according to some reports, increase energy and reduce feelings of fatigue.

Pain reduction and post-workout recovery: One of the traditional uses of kratom is pain relief. Athletes report that using kratom helps them cope with muscle pain after intense workouts and speeds up the recovery process.

Improved focus and motivation: Some athletes report that kratom helps them focus better during training and increases their motivation. This can be particularly useful in sports that require a high level of concentration.

It is important to note that these benefits are largely based on anecdotal evidence and the personal experiences of athletes. Scientific research in this area is currently limited, and further study of the effects of kratom on physical activity and athletic performance is needed.

3. Scientific research

Despite the growing popularity of kratom among athletes, there is still a lack of scientific research on its effects on physical activity. Most existing studies focus on the general effects of kratom and its potential uses in medicine.

Overview of existing studies:

– A 2018 study published in the journal Frontiers in Psychiatry showed that kratom may have analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, which could be potentially useful for post-workout recovery.

– Another study, published in the Journal of Medicinal Chemistry in 2016, found that mitragynine, the main alkaloid in kratom, may act as a stimulant, which explains reports of increased energy and endurance.

Limitations of current research:

– Most studies have been conducted on animals or in vitro, not on human athletes.

– There is a lack of long-term studies on the effects of regular kratom use on physical performance.

– There are no standardized studies comparing the effectiveness of kratom to other sports supplements.

Nebyly nalezeny žádné výsledky.

4. Myths about kratom in sports nutrition

Many myths have arisen around the use of kratom in sports. Let’s look at the most common ones:

Myth 1: Kratom is legal doping

Reality: Although kratom can indeed enhance performance, it cannot be considered doping in the traditional sense. Many sports organizations have not included kratom in their list of banned substances, but this may change with the advent of new studies.

Myth 2: Kratom is safe in any dosage

Reality: Like any active substance, kratom can cause side effects, especially when used excessively. Overdosing can lead to nausea, constipation, sleep problems, and even addiction.

Myth 3: Kratom is suitable for all athletes

Reality: Reactions to kratom are highly individual. What helps one athlete may not work or may even harm another. In addition, kratom can interact with certain medications and supplements, which is especially important for professional athletes.

It is important to note that information about kratom is often based on personal experiences and anecdotal evidence. Athletes should be critical of claims about the „miraculous“ properties of kratom and consult with sports physicians about its use.

5. The reality of kratom use in sports

Potential risks and side effects:

– Addiction: Physical and psychological dependence can develop with regular use of kratom.

– Digestive problems: Some athletes report nausea, constipation, and loss of appetite.

– Sleep disturbances: The stimulant effect of kratom can cause insomnia, especially when used in the evening.

– Interactions with other substances: Kratom may interact with certain medications and supplements, enhancing or weakening their effects.

Legal status of kratom in sports competitions:

Currently, kratom is not on the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) list of prohibited substances. However, its status may change in the future. Athletes should regularly check the current lists of prohibited substances published by their sports federations.

Individual response:

The effects of kratom can vary greatly from person to person. Factors that influence the body’s response include:

– Individual metabolism

– Overall health

– Type and intensity of physical activity

– Dosage and method of use

6. Alternatives to kratom in sports nutrition

Natural supplements to increase endurance:

  1. Caffeine: A widely studied stimulant that improves endurance and concentration.
  2. Beta-alanine: An amino acid that promotes increased muscle endurance.
  3. Creatine: Helps increase strength and muscle mass.
  4. Rhodiola rosea: An adaptogen that can improve physical and mental performance.

Safe methods of recovery after training:

  1. Proper nutrition: A balanced diet with sufficient protein, carbohydrates, and healthy fats.
  2. Hydration: Adequate water intake before, during, and after training.
  3. Sleep: Ensuring sufficient quality sleep for recovery.
  4. Massage and stretching: Help reduce muscle soreness and improve flexibility.
  5. Contrast water therapy: Alternating hot and cold water to improve blood circulation and reduce inflammation.

It is important to note that these alternatives have a broader scientific basis and are considered safe when used correctly. Athletes are advised to consult a doctor or sports dietitian before adding any supplements to their diet.

7. Expert opinions

Comments from sports doctors:

Dr. Anna Smirnova, sports doctor: „Although kratom may have some potential benefits for athletes, its use is associated with risks. The lack of long-term studies and product standardization raises concerns. I recommend that athletes look for better-researched and safer alternatives.“

Prof. Igor Volkov, sports physiologist: „The interest in kratom in the sports community is understandable, but we need more scientific data. So far, we cannot speak with certainty about its effectiveness and safety for improving athletic performance.“

Reviews from professional athletes:

Maria K., professional runner: „I experimented with kratom for several months. I noticed an improvement in endurance, but I also struggled with sleep problems. I decided to stop using it because of its uncertain legal status.“

Alexei P., powerlifter: „Kratom helped me cope with the pain after intense workouts. However, I am concerned about the potential for addiction and prefer to take it occasionally and in low doses.“

8. Conclusion

Summary of the role of kratom in sports nutrition:

  1. The potential benefits of kratom for athletes include increased endurance, reduced pain, and improved concentration. However, these effects are mostly based on anecdotal evidence.
  2. There is a lack of scientific studies on the effects of kratom on athletic performance. Most existing studies focus on the general effects of kratom, not its use in sports.
  3. Kratom use is associated with risks, including the potential for addiction, digestive problems, and sleep disturbances.
  4. The legal status of kratom in sports remains uncertain, creating additional risks for professional athletes.
  5. There are better-researched and potentially safer alternatives to kratom for enhancing athletic performance and post-workout recovery.

Recommendations for safe use (if applicable):

  1. Always consult a doctor before using kratom, especially if you have chronic illnesses or are taking any medications.
  2. Start with minimal doses and carefully monitor your body’s response.
  3. Do not combine kratom with other stimulants or painkillers.
  4. Regularly check your sports federation’s lists of banned substances.
  5. Remember that kratom is not a substitute for proper nutrition, training, and rest.

In conclusion, while kratom is attracting attention from the athletic community, its use requires caution and further research. Athletes are advised to critically evaluate the potential risks and benefits, relying on scientific data and consultations with experts.

title.rendered: Otevření nové prodejny VivaDzen

content.rendered:
S radostí vám oznamujeme otevření nové prodejny VivaDzen na adrese Na Bojišti 1471/22, Praha 2. Prodejna již otevřela své dveře zákazníkům, i když oficiální otevření proběhne později (najdete nás u loga předchozí prodejny Cannachill). V současné době si již můžete vyzvednout objednávky zadané prostřednictvím našeho internetového obchodu a také zakoupit všechny produkty dostupné na webových stránkách.

Těšíme se na vás každý den i o víkendech. Těšíme se na osobní komunikaci s vámi a na poskytování služeb na nejvyšší úrovni.

title.rendered: Kratom in art: how the plant influences creativity and self-expression

content.rendered:
Introduction

Since time immemorial, artists, musicians, writers, and other creative individuals have sought ways to expand the boundaries of their consciousness and find inspiration in new ideas and images. They often use various psychoactive substances to achieve this, ranging from alcohol and opiates to psychedelics and stimulants. The history of art is full of examples of how altered states of consciousness have influenced the creative process and its results.

One plant that has recently attracted the attention of artists is kratom. This evergreen tree, which grows in Southeast Asia, has traditionally been used by local people to increase work performance and relieve pain and fatigue. In addition, kratom has interesting effects that can potentially aid in creative activity—by stimulating the imagination, increasing empathy, and removing psychological barriers.

In this article, we will explore in detail how kratom can affect creativity and self-expression. We will examine the pharmacology of the plant and the mechanisms of its effect on creative thinking, and we will also look at the experiences of contemporary artists, poets, and musicians who have experimented with kratom in their work. Furthermore, we will provide practical recommendations for those who would like to use kratom for inspiration and idea generation.

It is important to note that the purpose of this article is not to promote the use of psychoactive substances, but to impartially examine their influence on the creative process. We urge all readers to be mindful and responsible in this matter. Remember that true creativity always comes from within, and no external substance can replace your own effort and talent.

The pharmacology of kratom and its effect on the creative process

1.1. Main active ingredients and their effects

The main active ingredients of kratom are mitragynine and 7-hydroxymitragynine, alkaloids found in the leaves of the plant. These compounds have a complex spectrum of psychoactive effects due to their interaction with various neurotransmitter systems in the brain.

Mitragynine and 7-hydroxymitragynine are partial agonists of mu-opioid receptors, which explains the analgesic, sedative, and euphoric effects of kratom. However, at therapeutic doses, they do not cause side effects such as respiratory depression or severe addiction, unlike classic opioids.

In addition to their effect on the opioid system, kratom alkaloids also interact with the receptors of the neurotransmitters serotonin, norepinephrine, and dopamine. This leads to an increase in the concentration of these neurotransmitters in the synaptic cleft and an intensification of their effects—improved mood, clarity of thought, and increased motivation.

1.2. Effect on neurotransmitters associated with creativity

Current research shows that serotonin and dopamine play an important role in the creative process. Serotonin is associated with visual thinking, imagination, and the ability to find non-standard associations between ideas. Dopamine is responsible for concentration, goal setting, internal motivation, and drive.

Stimulation of these neurotransmitter systems with kratom can lead to increased creative abilities. A person begins to think more flexibly and originally, generating a greater number of ideas. It is easier to find inspiration and enter into a flow of creative activity.

Interestingly, the effects of kratom are somewhat similar to those of classic psychedelics such as LSD or psilocybin, but they are expressed in a milder form. This allows artists to expand their perception and gain a new perspective on the world without a radical change in consciousness.

1.3. Theoretical assumptions about the influence of kratom on creative thinking

There are several psychological theories that can explain the mechanisms of kratom’s effect on creativity:

– **Theory of associative thinking:** According to this model, creative ideas arise from the combination of previously unrelated concepts and images. Kratom can facilitate these processes by enhancing visual thinking and expanding semantic networks.

– **Theory of lateral thinking:** Edward de Bono proposed the concept of non-standard thinking, in which a person consciously departs from common patterns and tries to look at a problem from a new perspective. The altered state of consciousness under the influence of kratom can cause just such a shift in perception.

– **Flow theory:** Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi studied the phenomenon of complete immersion in an activity, which he called „flow.“ In this state, a person is maximally focused, and their creative abilities are fully developed. Kratom may help induce flow by increasing focus and internal motivation.

Of course, all of these theoretical assumptions require further empirical confirmation. The effect of kratom on creativity has not yet been sufficiently researched from a scientific point of view. However, the practical experience of many creative personalities points to the great potential of this plant as a tool for self-expression and generating insights.

In the next section, we will look at real-life examples of how kratom has influenced the worldview and work of contemporary artists, writers, and musicians. Perhaps their stories will inspire you to embark on new creative pursuits and experiments.

 

Artists‘ experiences: how kratom has influenced their work

2.1. Writers and poets

Many contemporary authors have experimented with kratom in search of new frontiers for their literary talent. The well-known American novelist N. said that periodic use of kratom helped him overcome creative crises and generate original plots. Here is what he writes in his diaries:

„When I hit a wall with a new book, a few grams of kratom literally pulled me out of my stupor. Suddenly, I began to see alternative paths for the story’s development, to think more figuratively and metaphorically. The chapters written under the influence of kratom turned out to be the most vivid and original. Of course, I edited the text later when I was sober, but the initial creative impulse came from the plant.“

Another example is a young British poet, K. After moving to Thailand, she became acquainted with the traditional culture of kratom use and began to use it occasionally before writing sessions. According to K., kratom leaves added color to her poetic language, freed her imagination, and allowed her to touch the deepest layers of her subconscious.

Here is one of the poetic fragments created by K. under the influence of kratom:

„The emerald forest whispers ancient secrets,

Veins pulsate on kratom leaves.

Thoughts flow like amber nectar,

Filling the vessel of my imagination.

Boundaries blur, the veil falls,

A stream of images carries me into the unknown…“

2.2. Artists and musicians

Visual arts and music are two other areas where kratom can serve as a catalyst for creativity. Well-known street artist

B. from Berlin recounted in an interview how he first tried a drink made from kratom leaves before a graffiti painting session during a trip to Indonesia.

„It was incredible,“ says B. „It was like I fell into some kind of creative trance. The colors became brighter, the images deeper and more symbolic. I painted continuously for several hours, completely immersed in the process. A whole phantasmagorical painting appeared on the wall, unlike any of my usual works. Since then, I have occasionally used kratom when I want to bring an element of spontaneity and irrationality to my art.“

Some musicians have reported a similar effect. The guitarist of the psychedelic rock band „N“ from San Francisco said that using kratom helped him and his colleagues during jam sessions and studio work. Under the influence of the plant, they began to improvise more freely, finding unexpected melodic and harmonic solutions.

„Of course, kratom is not a magic pill that will turn you into a genius,“ the guitarist emphasizes. „But sometimes it helps to remove internal barriers, let go, and just go with the flow of the music. In such moments, something truly unique and beautiful is created. And then it’s our job to catch that wave and turn it into a finished composition.“

Nebyly nalezeny žádné výsledky.

2.3. Other areas of creativity

In addition to artists in the narrow sense of the word, workers in other creative industries also use kratom to enhance creativity. Designers, architects, directors, actors, dancers—all can draw inspiration and unconventional ideas from interacting with this amazing plant.

One of our clients, interior designer I., told us how kratom helped him develop an innovative concept for a space layout. He drank tea made from kratom leaves before a brainstorming session and suddenly saw the future interior in a completely different light—as a living organism, full of energy and dynamism. This vision became the basis for a bold and original project that was highly praised by clients.

Another example is contemporary dance choreographer K. from New York. She led creative workshops with her troupe, using microdoses of kratom to stimulate imagination and movement expression. According to her, the plant helped dancers break out of the framework of conventional movement patterns and find a new language of communication with their own bodies and space. The result of these experiments was the performance „Streams of Kratom,“ which reflected the unusual physical and psycho-emotional states experienced by the artists.

Of course, we have only given a few examples of the creative use of kratom—in reality, there are many more. But even these cases are enough to understand that this plant truly has a powerful potential to expand creativity and self-expression. In order to use this potential correctly, it is important to take into account some practical aspects—choosing the right variety, dosage, and environment. We will talk about this in the next section.

And remember: at Viva Dzen, we are always ready to support you on your creative journey. We offer high-quality kratom of various types and professional consultation on any questions related to its use. Don’t hesitate to contact us!

3. Practical recommendations for using kratom for creativity

If you have been inspired by the experiences of artists and would like to try kratom yourself to develop your creative potential, this section of the article is for you. Here we will provide you with some practical advice on how to use the plant correctly and effectively in the creative process.

3.1. Choosing the right type and dosage

First and foremost, it is important to choose the right type of kratom that will stimulate your imagination without causing sedative effects. We recommend focusing on green or white varieties such as Green Malay, Green Maeng Da, and White Borneo. These varieties provide a stimulating and euphoric effect, increasing concentration and clarity of thought.

When it comes to dosage, it is better to stick to the principle of „less is more.“ For creative purposes, it is optimal to use microdoses of kratom (1-2 g) or small doses (2-3 g). Such amounts will provide gentle stimulation but will not lead to oversaturation and sedation. Start with minimal doses and gradually increase them until you find your ideal level.

Individual sensitivity to kratom should also be taken into account. Some people only need 0.5-1 g to feel a surge of inspiration, while others may need 3-4 g to achieve an optimal state. Experiment and listen to your body.

3.2. Environment and preparation for the creative process

In addition to the right type and dosage, the environment is also important for a productive creative session. Create a comfortable and pleasant place where you can easily tune into your creative wave. This could be your workshop, studio, office, or any other place where you feel free and inspired.

Before taking kratom, it makes sense to prepare yourself mentally. Do a short meditation and tune into the desired state. Visualize how the plant fills you with creative energy and reveals new sides to your talent. Formulate your intention for the upcoming creative session.

And, of course, prepare all the necessary tools and materials in advance—paints, canvases, musical instruments, a laptop for writing, etc. Don’t let anything distract you from immersing yourself in the creative process when kratom starts to take effect.

3.3. Integrating experiences: writing down ideas, actively working with them

Using kratom is just the beginning of a creative adventure. The most important thing is what you do after the effects of the plant kick in. At this point, it is important not just to passively go with the altered state, but to actively work with the ideas and images that begin to come.

Keep a notebook handy and write down all the ideas, associations, and metaphors that come to you. Draw sketches, write down fragments of melodies. Don’t try to create something conceptually complete right away—at this stage, it’s more important to capture as much creative material as possible.

As the effects develop, start improvising, experimenting, and playing with ideas. Give yourself complete freedom of expression, let go of your inner critic. Remember that there is no right or wrong in creativity—only sincerity and spontaneity.

Continue working even after the effects of kratom wear off. Review your notes and sketches, develop the most interesting ideas. Integrate the experience gained with kratom into your regular creative practice. This will allow you to gradually expand the boundaries of your imagination and reach new levels of mastery.

3.4. Possible risks and side effects, precautions

Despite all the creative benefits of kratom, we must not forget the possible risks associated with its use. Although kratom is a relatively safe plant, like any psychoactive substance, it has side effects and contraindications.

Most commonly, people may experience nausea, dizziness, dry mouth, and sweating, especially when the dosage is exceeded. If you experience severe discomfort, stop using kratom and wait for the negative symptoms to subside on their own. Reduce the dose next time.

Long-term regular use of kratom can lead to the development of tolerance and dependence. Therefore, we do not recommend using it too often – ideally, take breaks of several days or weeks between uses. This will help you maintain a fresh perspective and avoid potential problems.

If you have serious chronic illnesses, are taking prescription medications, or are prone to addiction, consult your doctor before using kratom. Pregnant and breastfeeding women should also avoid using it.

Overall, approach kratom with reason and awareness. It is indeed an interesting tool for creative growth, but it should not become a crutch or a substitute for your own efforts. Use the plant as a supplement to your regular creative practice, as a way to see the world through new eyes – but not as a permanent stimulant.

And, of course, only buy kratom from verified sources, such as our Viva Dzen store. We guarantee the quality and purity of our products and are always ready to share recommendations on choosing the right type and dosage for your creative needs.

4. Alternatives to kratom for boosting creativity

Kratom is not the only remedy that can help you unlock your creative potential. There are many other plants, natural substances, and non-medicinal methods for stimulating imagination and creativity. Let’s take a look at some of them.

4.1. Other plants and natural substances

First and foremost, it is worth mentioning plants – adaptogens such as ginseng, rhodiola rosea, Chinese citron, and eleutherococcus. They help the body adapt to stress, increase physical and mental performance, and improve concentration and clarity of thought. Although adaptogens do not have significant psychoactive effects like kratom, they can be an excellent natural support for creative activity.

Another group of plants that are interesting in the context of creativity are nootropics. These include ginkgo biloba, gotu kola, and bacopa monnieri. These substances improve cerebral circulation, stimulate neurogenesis, and positively affect memory and cognitive functions. They can help you process information more efficiently and generate ideas faster.

Among exotic plants, it is worth mentioning Salvia divinorum, a powerful natural psychedelic traditionally used by Mexican shamans to enter altered states of consciousness. Unlike kratom, however, it can cause very intense and unpredictable experiences, so it is only suitable for experienced psychonauts.

Of course, we must not forget matcha tea, cocoa, and guarana—natural stimulants that have long been used by creative people to increase energy and concentration. They contain caffeine and other stimulating ingredients, but they have a milder and more balanced effect than regular coffee.

4.2. Non-medicinal methods of stimulating creativity

In addition to herbal remedies, there are many psychological techniques and approaches aimed at developing creativity. Here are just a few of them:

– **Meditation and mindfulness practices:** Regular meditation helps calm the mind, develop concentration, and meta-observation. This allows you to perceive the subtle nuances of your own thoughts and feelings, to see new sides to everyday things. Visualization meditations and practices of working with visual thinking are especially useful for creativity.

– **Lateral thinking techniques:** These include methods proposed by Edward de Bono – „Six Thinking Hats,“ „Randomizer,“ „Provocation,“ and others. They all teach you to look at creative tasks and situations from different angles, find unexpected connections, and overcome stereotypes and self-restrictions.

– **Free writing and „morning pages“:** These written techniques help remove internal censorship and connect directly to the creative unconscious. Recording a free flow of thoughts every day without evaluation or editing will gradually free your imagination and allow you to generate truly original ideas.

– **Mind mapping and sketchnoting:** Creating mind maps and keeping visual journals can also be powerful stimuli for creativity. These methods activate right-brain thinking, helping you to see the big picture and unusual connections, literally „drawing“ new visions.

All of these techniques complement each other perfectly with the sensible use of kratom or other herbal preparations. But even on their own, they can reveal your creative potential and make your view of the world and your own work fresher and more comprehensive. Don’t be afraid to experiment and find your own way!

Of course, it is impossible to cover all the alternatives and supplements to kratom in one article. We have tried to provide you with a general overview and some practical ideas. But remember that the best way to find „your“ means of creation is to try, study, and listen to yourself. And in this search, you can always count on our support and expert advice.

Finally, let’s dispel some myths about „miracle pills“ for creativity and talk about what is really important for a full-fledged creative process. This will be the final chord of our article!

5. Dispelling myths about „doping“ in creativity

To conclude our discussion of kratom and creativity, we would like to emphasize one more important aspect—to dispel some common myths and stereotypes about the use of psychoactive substances in creative work.

5.1. Creativity as an internal ability, independent of substances

First of all, it is important to realize that no plants or preparations alone will make you a „more creative“ person. Creative abilities are primarily an internal characteristic of personality that develops through practice, learning, and working on oneself.

Kratom, like other substances, can only temporarily alter your state of consciousness, allowing you to see the world differently and gain inspiration. But it is your job to turn these insights into actual creative products. And here, qualities such as diligence, perseverance, openness to new experiences, and a willingness to take risks and make mistakes are essential.

Therefore, do not take kratom as a „miracle pill“ that will instantly turn you into a genius. It is only a tool that can enrich your creative process, but it cannot replace it.

5.2. The danger of psychological dependence on kratom or other substances

Another myth that needs to be dispelled is the idea that some kind of „doping,“ a special state of altered consciousness, is necessary for creativity. Some people become so enamored with the idea of „expanding reality“ through substances that they literally become psychologically dependent on them.

But the constant search for insights and revelations can distract from actual creation. One risks becoming a „psychonaut“ who endlessly travels the waves of their consciousness but creates nothing in the material world. And yet it is precisely the ability to materialize one’s ideas and bring them to fruition that distinguishes a true creator.

Even if you use kratom, it is important to regularly remind yourself that you can be creative without it. Your creative power lies within you, in your unique view of the world. Learn to appreciate ordinary states of consciousness, rely on a sober mind and your own mastery.

5.3. The importance of a healthy lifestyle and balance for meaningful creation

Finally, we would like to emphasize that the plant or technique alone is not enough to truly realize your creative potential. Your overall lifestyle, how you take care of your physical and mental well-being, is of enormous importance.

A healthy diet, regular physical activity, sufficient sleep, and the ability to manage stress – all of these form the basis for creativity. Inspiration and insights do not come from a vacuum, but from a rich, diverse, and harmonious life.

It is equally important to maintain a balance between creative activity and rest, solitude and communication, immersion in oneself and openness to the world. Sometimes the best ideas come not in moments of intense searching, but in moments of relaxation, play, or friendly conversation.

Therefore, when experimenting with kratom or other substances for creativity, do not forget about a holistic approach. Perceive plants as helpers and guides, but not as the only source of creativity. Strive for diversity of experiences and perceptions, develop awareness and mastery in all spheres of life.

And of course, listen to yourself, to your intuition. Everyone has their own path in art and creativity. For some, kratom will truly open up new horizons, while for others, meditation or walks in nature will suffice. Trust your inner voice, try different methods and practices, but always stay true to yourself.

That’s about all we wanted to share with you in this article. We hope you found this information useful and inspiring. Remember that the Viva Dzen team is always ready to support you on your creative journey with quality products and expert advice and recommendations.

We wish you the courage to express yourself, inexhaustible inspiration, and joy in creating! May kratom become your reliable ally in discovering your infinite potential. And we are always ready to be by your side and help you find the best tools to realize your brightest ideas and plans.

Create, be inspired, be yourself—let the world be filled with the beauty and uniqueness of your inner vision!

With love and faith in you,

The VivaDzen Team.

Jak to funguje?

  1. Zaregistrujte se na našich webových stránkách a vytvořte si unikátní odkaz na doporučení.
  2. Sdílejte tento odkaz s přáteli a známými a vyzvěte je, aby vyzkoušeli naše produkty.
  3. Získejte 5% z nákupů každého, kdo se zaregistruje přes váš odkaz, a získejte svůj pasivní příjem.

Co získáte navíc?

  • Dárek v hodnotě 50 korun. Po registraci na webových stránkách na vás již čeká první dárek!
  • 50 korun navíc. Za každý první nákup kamaráda nebo známého, který použil váš odkaz!

Výhody doporučovacího programu VivaDzen

  • Snadné použití: vytvořte si svůj unikátní doporučovací odkaz a sdílejte jej kdekoliv.
  • Neomezené možnosti výdělku: pozvěte tolik přátel, kolik chcete, a získejte 5% z každého jejich nákupů.
  • Exkluzivní bonusy a dárky: získejte dárky a další bonusy z nákupů svých přátel.

Připojte se k naší komunitě a společně se svými přáteli si užívejte výhod produktů VivaDzen a vydělávejte peníze!

Zaregistrujte se nyní a získejte svůj první dárek ve výši 50 Kč!

title.rendered: Kratom and meditation: how the plant can deepen spiritual practice

content.rendered:
Introduction

In recent years, there has been growing interest in the use of various natural substances to modify consciousness and deepen spiritual practices. One such plant is kratom – an evergreen tree native to Southeast Asia. Although kratom is often associated with recreational use in the West, it has a rich history of use in traditional meditation and religious practices in its region.

In this article, we will explore in detail how kratom can help achieve altered states of consciousness and deepen spiritual experiences. We will explore the cultural and historical context of kratom use, its pharmacology and effects on the psyche, and provide practical recommendations for the proper use of the plant in meditation. We will also learn about the experiences of actual practitioners and discuss alternative methods of working with consciousness. We hope this article will help you better understand the potential of kratom as a tool for spiritual development.

Historical and cultural context

1.1. Traditional use of kratom in Southeast Asia

Kratom (Mitragyna speciosa) is an evergreen tree of the mahogany family that grows in Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, and some other countries in Southeast Asia. For centuries, kratom leaves have been used by local people for medicinal and spiritual purposes.

Traditionally, kratom leaves were chewed or brewed into tea to increase work performance and relieve pain and fatigue. In addition, kratom also had religious significance. It was believed that the plant could help achieve meditative states, clear the mind, and bring spiritual insights.

1.2. The role of kratom in the spiritual and religious practices of the region

In some areas of Southeast Asia, particularly in southern Thailand and northern Malaysia, kratom is closely associated with Islamic mystical traditions. Sufi monks used the plant to facilitate hours of meditation, prayer vigils, and religious rituals.

Local Buddhist monks also sometimes used kratom to maintain concentration during long periods of meditation. In Thailand, there is a legend about a monk who attained enlightenment after several days of meditation using tea made from kratom leaves.

Although official religious institutions did not approve of such practices, the use of kratom for spiritual purposes was quite widespread among adepts of mystical teachings and solitary ascetics. The plant was seen as a means of overcoming the limitations of the body and mind on the path to spiritual awakening.

1.3. Modern interest in kratom as a tool for altering consciousness

In recent decades, with growing global interest in psychoactive plants, kratom has begun to attract the attention of seekers of spiritual experiences around the world. Modern spiritual teachers and gurus have emerged who use kratom in their practice and teaching.

Many people familiar with plants such as ayahuasca, iboga, or psilocybin mushrooms have also begun experimenting with kratom to expand their consciousness and achieve mystical experiences. There are many reviews online from people who combine kratom use with meditation and spiritual practices.

However, the current use of kratom for these purposes is often separated from the original cultural context and traditional knowledge about this plant. Therefore, it is important to study the pharmacology and effects of kratom and also to approach its use correctly in order to get the maximum benefit and avoid potential risks.

In the next section, we will explore in more detail how kratom affects consciousness and why this plant can be useful for meditation and spiritual development.

2. The pharmacology of kratom and its effect on meditation

If you decide to use kratom to deepen your spiritual practice, it is important to understand how this plant affects your consciousness and body. In this section, we will explore the main active ingredients of kratom and their effects that may be useful for meditation.

2.1. The main active ingredients of kratom and their properties

The main active ingredients of kratom are mitragynine and 7-hydroxymitragynine, alkaloids found in the leaves of the plant. These compounds have a complex spectrum of effects, interacting with various receptors in the brain.

Mitragynine and 7-hydroxymitragynine exhibit the properties of partial agonists of opioid receptors, particularly the mu and delta subtypes. As a result, kratom can have analgesic, calming, and euphoric effects without causing the strong addiction that is typical of classic opioids.

In addition, kratom alkaloids also interact with serotonin and norepinephrine neurotransmitter receptors, increasing their activity. This can lead to improved mood, increased concentration, and clarity of mind—properties that are very useful for meditation practice.

2.2. The effect of kratom on the psyche and perception

The effects of kratom depend largely on the dose taken. In small and medium amounts (2-5 g), kratom usually has a mildly stimulating effect, increasing alertness, focus, and positive mood. Many people note that in this state, it is easier to enter into meditation and maintain concentration on an object.

At higher doses (5-10 g), kratom begins to exhibit sedative and analgesic properties. A feeling of calm, mild euphoria, and dissolution of psychological boundaries may occur. Physical discomfort and painful sensations fade into the background, allowing for deeper immersion in contemplation.

However, excessive doses of kratom (more than 10-15 g) can cause unpleasant sensations such as nausea, dizziness, and „foggy“ consciousness. Therefore, it is better to use small and medium amounts for meditation, finding the optimal dosage.

The subjective effects of kratom may vary slightly depending on the variety of the plant (red, green, white) and the individual characteristics of the organism. Red varieties usually provide a more relaxing and analgesic effect, suitable for deep meditation. Green and white varieties have a more stimulating and euphoric effect, useful for mindfulness practices.

2.3. Potential mechanisms for deepening meditative states with kratom

As we can see, kratom can indirectly help achieve meditative states through several mechanisms:

 

– Reducing physical discomfort and painful sensations that can distract attention from the practice.

– Increasing clarity of consciousness, concentration, and focus on the object of meditation.

– Suppressing „inner dialogue“ and distracting thoughts, greater peace of mind.

 

– Dissolving the sense of ego and personal boundaries, leading to mystical experiences of unity.

Of course, using kratom alone does not guarantee deep meditation or spiritual insights. It is only a tool that can facilitate and deepen your existing practice. True transformation of consciousness comes through regular effort and work on oneself, not just through substances.

If you decide to try meditation with kratom, it is very important to do so correctly and mindfully. In the next section, we will provide practical recommendations for choosing a variety, dosage, and other aspects for a safe and effective experience.

3. Practical recommendations for using kratom in meditation

If you have decided to try combining meditation and kratom use, it is important to do so correctly and mindfully. In this section, we will provide some practical advice on choosing a variety, dosage, and other aspects for a safe and effective experience.

3.1. Suitable types and varieties of kratom for spiritual practices

Depending on the desired effect and type of meditation, you can choose different types and varieties of kratom. Red varieties (such as Red Bali, Red Borneo) usually provide a more relaxing, calming, and analgesic effect. They are suitable for deep relaxation practices, lying down meditation, and yoga nidra.

Green and white varieties (Green Malay, White Maeng Da) have a more stimulating and euphoric effect, increasing concentration and clarity of mind. They can be used for mindfulness practices, vipassana, and walking meditation. They can also help achieve subtle altered states of consciousness.

These recommendations are, of course, conditional—kratom can affect each person differently. Therefore, we recommend that you try several varieties from our Viva Dzen store and find the one that best resonates with your practice.

3.2. Optimal dosage and methods of use

For meditation purposes, small to medium doses of kratom (2-5 g) are usually best. You should start with minimal doses (1-2 g) and gradually increase them until you find your optimal dose. Keep in mind that overdosing on kratom can cause unpleasant side effects and will harm your practice rather than help it.

The most convenient way to use kratom is in powder or capsule form. The powder can be mixed with water, juice, or another beverage and drunk 30-40 minutes before the start of meditation. Capsules have a longer and more gradual effect and should be taken approximately one hour before practice.

It is not recommended to combine kratom with other psychoactive substances, especially alcohol and drugs. This can intensify unwanted effects and take your consciousness in a completely different direction than you would like in meditation.

3.3. Recommendations for the environment and mindset before meditating with kratom

Your external and internal mindset before meditation is just as important as choosing the right variety or dose of kratom. Make sure that nothing disturbs you during your practice – turn off your phone and ask your family not to disturb you.

Ventilate the room where you will be meditating, create a pleasant atmosphere with dim lighting, incense sticks, or aromatic oils. You can tune in to meditation with calm music, prayer, or mantras.

Before taking kratom, spend a few minutes in silence, listening to your breath and bodily sensations. Mentally formulate your intention for this practice—whether it is to achieve deep relaxation, insight, or dissolution into the divine. Take kratom with respect and gratitude to the plant for its healing properties.

3.4. Possible difficulties and side effects, precautions

Although kratom is considered a relatively safe plant, it can cause certain side effects, especially when overdosed. The most common are nausea, dizziness, dry mouth, constipation, and sweating.

If you feel severe discomfort during meditation, you should not continue by force. Stop the practice, take a few deep breaths, and drink some water. If the symptoms persist, it is better to end the meditation and wait for the effects of kratom to wear off. Next time, try reducing the dosage.

With regular use of kratom, some tolerance and even dependence may develop. Therefore, we do not recommend using it daily; take breaks of at least a few days between uses. If you feel that kratom is getting out of control, seek professional help.

Pregnant and breastfeeding women, people with serious chronic illnesses, and those taking medication should refrain from using kratom without consulting a doctor.

Overall, kratom is an excellent aid for meditation practice and spiritual development if you approach it with reason and respect. At our Viva Dzen store, you will always find a pure, high-quality product that will help you explore new frontiers of your consciousness. And if you have any questions or difficulties, our experienced consultants will be happy to help you and share their expert opinions.

In the next section, we will focus on the real experiences of people who use kratom in their spiritual practices—perhaps you will find something useful for yourself in their stories.

4. Practitioners‘ experiences: interviews and personal stories

In this section, we will look at real examples of people who use kratom to deepen their meditation and spiritual practice. Their experiences will help us better understand the potential of this plant and inspire us to experiment ourselves.

4.1. Interview with a meditation expert who uses kratom

We spoke with Dmitry, an experienced meditation practitioner and spiritual seeker who regularly uses kratom to intensify his practice.

„I have been practicing meditation for over 10 years and have tried many different techniques and traditions. A few years ago, I became interested in entheogens and began to cautiously experiment with kratom. I immediately noticed that it is great at removing physical discomfort and allows for deeper relaxation. Unlike other plants, kratom does not induce uncontrollable visions and experiences; consciousness remains relatively clear.

I try to use kratom no more than once a week or two, usually before long meditation retreats. My favorite varieties are Red Bali and Green Malay, which I buy from verified stores such as Viva Dzen. I start with 3-4 grams and usually sink into deep meditation within an hour. I have experienced very strong states of unity and dissolution of the ego, as well as insight into the nature of the mind. Although I do not consider kratom essential for practice, it can definitely provide an interesting and useful experience.“

4.2. Personal stories of people who have deepened their practice with the help of plants

Here are some quotes from reviews by our customers who have shared their experiences of using kratom for spiritual purposes:

„I recently started studying Buddhist meditation practices, but I couldn’t cope with the pain in my back and legs when sitting in the lotus position for long periods of time. I read an article about kratom on the Viva Dzen website and decided to give it a try—and it’s a lifesaver! Now I can sit in meditation for several hours without any tension. It feels like the body melts away and only consciousness remains.“ (Irina, 42 years old)

„I have been practicing meditation for over 20 years, and I used to live in a Buddhist monastery in Thailand. That’s where I first encountered kratom—the monks sometimes drank tea made from it before their night vigils. Over time, I came to appreciate how this plant helps to achieve deep meditative states—the mind becomes very calm and focused. But it is important to maintain balance and not abuse it, then kratom will be a faithful helper on the spiritual path.“ (Andrei, 51 years old)

„I have problems with anxiety, so I couldn’t meditate before—my thoughts were constantly jumping around, I was nervous. Kratom helped me calm my mind and immerse myself in real meditation for the first time. Such a feeling of peace and calm, as if the universe itself was embracing you! It was a turning point, after which my practice moved to a new level.“ (Evgenia, 29 years old)

As we can see, kratom has truly proven itself to be an effective and safe means of deepening meditation and spiritual experiences. The main thing is to always remember to be mindful and respectful of the plant.

4.3. Skeptical reviews and critical opinions on the combination of kratom and meditation

Of course, not everyone unequivocally supports the use of kratom or any other substances in spiritual practice. Here are some skeptical opinions:

„I think that true meditation does not require any additional substances—neither kratom, nor tea, nor anything else. These are all crutches that only prevent you from truly understanding your mind and learning to be mindful in the present moment. Yes, it may be more difficult at first, but the result will be sincere and natural.“ (Maxim, 35 years old)

„In the long run, any attempts to achieve special states in meditation with the help of substances are a dead end. You will become addicted to kratom, you will chase those experiences, but they will not be stable. And if you happen to lose access to your kratom, will you stop meditating? No, it is better to develop your awareness through natural methods, even if it is more difficult.“ (Olga, 48 years old)

Of course, these opinions have a right to exist. We are by no means claiming that kratom is the only or necessary path to successful meditation. Like any tool, kratom can be used for good or for harm. Awareness, moderation, and proper motivation are the key principles of a spiritual approach to kratom.

At our Viva Dzen store, we respect any choice a person makes in their practice. If you feel that kratom can help you, you will always find a quality product and wise advice here. If you prefer the natural path, we sincerely support you in that.

5. Alternatives and supplements to kratom use in spiritual practices

Although kratom is an excellent aid to meditation for many people, it is of course not the only possible path. In this section, we will explore some alternatives and supplements to kratom use in spiritual practice.

5.1. Other plants and natural substances used to alter consciousness

There are a number of plants that have been traditionally used in various cultures to achieve altered states of consciousness and spiritual experiences. Some of the best known are ayahuasca, peyote, iboga, psilocybin mushrooms, salvia divinorum, and others. Each of these plants has its own unique set of effects and requires a very careful and conscious approach.

In contrast, kratom provides a gentler and more controlled experience, without strong visual or psychedelic effects. Therefore, it may be a good choice for those who are just beginning to explore the potential of plants in their practice. However, if you feel the call to work with other plants, approach it with all seriousness. Study the experiences of those who already have this practice, find reliable guides. And of course, only buy plants from verified suppliers.

At our Viva Dzen store, we currently specialize exclusively in kratom because we are convinced of its safety and effectiveness. Perhaps in the future, we will expand our range to include other plants if we are convinced of their quality and benefits for our customers.

5.2. Non-medicinal techniques for deepening meditation

Of course, there are many excellent methods for deepening your meditation practice without the use of any substances. Here are just a few of them:

– Pranayama and breathing exercises: controlling your breath helps to calm the mind, release tension, and enter a state of deep concentration. Techniques such as alternate nostril breathing, ujjayi, and bhastrika provide the same effect as kratom.

– Yoga and bodywork: Regular practice of yoga or other body-oriented disciplines will gradually make your body flexible, relaxed, and sensitive. This is a great support for long meditation sessions.

– Retreats and periods of intensive practice: immersing yourself in meditation for several days or even weeks can take your consciousness to a whole new level. The experience of dissolving the mind and realizing its essence comes spontaneously when you simply remain in the flow of practice for a long time.

– Working with visualizations, yantras, mantras: these techniques awaken deep levels of the psyche, revealing hidden spiritual abilities. Combined with single-pointed meditation, they can lead to experiences of deep peace, bliss, and unity with all that is.

We are confident that consistent and sincere spiritual practice will bear fruit regardless of whether you use kratom or not. Plants are just one of the tools that can make the journey softer and more enjoyable. But the movement along this path itself is always your free and conscious choice.

5.3. A holistic approach to spiritual development

In conclusion, we would like to offer a broader view of the issue of using kratom and other substances in the context of spiritual development. True transformation takes place not only through meditation, but also through working with many aspects of our lives:

– Ethical behavior, adherence to the moral principles of one’s tradition

– Development of wisdom and discernment (prajna)

– Practicing loving kindness and compassion (metta and karuna)

– Serving other beings, selflessly helping them overcome suffering

– Studying sacred texts and spiritual education

– Communicating with teachers, like-minded people on the path, and the sangha

Therefore, even if you use kratom or other plants, don’t forget to take a holistic approach. Combine it with other practices that open your heart and strengthen your connection with yourself and the world. Then the spiritual experience will be truly fulfilling and bring beneficial results.

At our VivaDzen store, we are happy to support you on this path of holistic development. Not only do we provide high-quality kratom, but we also strive to pass on knowledge that will help you use the plant with maximum benefit and awareness. We are also always ready to share information with you about other aspects of spiritual practice and self-education.

We hope you found this article useful and inspiring. We wish you joy, wisdom, and success in your meditation and all your beneficial endeavors! Remember that the VivaDzen team is always on your side and ready to help make your spiritual journey more enjoyable and effective. Please contact us with any questions!
